comparisons.peer_summary: A significant portion of the company's revenue comes from a limited number of customers, with the three largest customers accounting for 45% of net revenue in 2024, creating volatility and operational risk upon their loss or reduction in orders.
comparisons.comparison: Both AVGO and INTC disclose significant customer concentration risk, noting that a small number of customers account for a large portion of net revenue and that this trend is expected to continue, posing a risk to results of operations if those customers are lost. However, the specific metrics differ: AVGO discloses that direct sales to a single distributor accounted for 28% of net revenue in 2024, with the top five end customers representing approximately 40%. In contrast, INTC reports that its three largest customers collectively accounted for 45% of net revenue in 2024.

sentences.text: Direct sales to one customer, which is a distributor, accounted for 28% and 21% of our net revenue for fiscal years 2024 and 2023, respectively.
We believe aggregate sales to our top five end customers, through all channels, accounted for approximately 40% and 35% of our net revenue for fiscal years 2024 and 2023, respectively.
We expect to continue to experience significant customer concentration in future periods.
The loss of, or significant decrease in demand from, any of our top five end customers could have a material adverse effect on our business, results of operations and financial condition.
We receive a significant portion of our revenue from a limited number of customers.
Collectively, our three largest customers accounted for 45% of our net revenue in 2024, 40% of our net revenue in 2023 and 42% of our net revenue in 2022.
We expect a small number of customers will continue to account for a significant portion of our revenue in the foreseeable future.

The loss of key customers, a substantial reduction in sales to them, or changes in the timing of their orders can lead to a reduction in our revenue, increase the volatility of our results, and harm our results of operations and financial condition.

peer_results.rationale: The provided MU candidates discuss macroeconomic demand weakness, inventory reductions, and cybersecurity reviews in China, but do not disclose specific customer concentration metrics or risks related to revenue dependence on a small number of key customers.

comparisons.peer_summary: Sales to Customer A represented 13% of fiscal 2024 total revenue in the Compute & Networking segment, while one indirect customer accounted for approximately 19%, attributable to the same segment. This contrasts with fiscal years 2023 and 2022, where no single customer accounted for 10% or more of total revenue, although demand is expected to remain concentrated.
comparisons.comparison: Both AVGO and NVDA identify specific customer concentration risks in their 2024 filings, though the nature of the concentration differs. AVGO highlights a single distributor accounting for 28% of net revenue and top five end customers representing 40%. NVDA discloses that a single direct customer ('Customer A') accounted for 13% of total revenue, and one indirect customer accounted for approximately 19% of total revenue. Both companies note that demand/concentration is expected to remain significant or concentrated in the future, whereas NVDA specifically contrasts 2024 with prior years (2022-2023) where no single customer accounted for 10% or more of revenue, a historical context not provided for AVGO's single distributor figure in the same sentence.

sentences.text: Direct sales to one customer, which is a distributor, accounted for 28% and 21% of our net revenue for fiscal years 2024 and 2023, respectively.
We expect to continue to experience significant customer concentration in future periods.
The loss of, or significant decrease in demand from, any of our top five end customers could have a material adverse effect on our business, results of operations and financial condition.
Sales to one customer, Customer A, represented 13% of total revenue for fiscal year 2024, which was attributable to the Compute & Networking segment.

One indirect customer which primarily purchases our products through system integrators and distributors, including through Customer A, is estimated to have represented approximately 19% of total revenue for fiscal year 2024, attributable to the Compute & Networking segment.
Our estimated Compute & Networking demand is expected to remain concentrated.
There were no customers with 10% or more of total revenue for fiscal years 2023 and 2022.
